name: go-cart
description: GoCart — a full-stack multi-vendor e-commerce portfolio project by Rakib Hasan Sohag. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma and PostgreSQL; customer, seller and admin demos.

paragraphs: GoCart is a full-stack multi-vendor e-commerce portfolio project by Rakib Hasan Sohag, built with Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, and TanStack Query. It unifies customer discovery, seller storefront management, real-time messaging, automated payout disbursements via Stripe Connect, and an administrative control hub.
Live demo · Browse stores · User guides and demo accounts
Explore customer shopping, seller catalog and order management, and admin marketplace operations. Payments use sandbox providers in this portfolio demo.
